reason: Goals can now be edited through a revision-safe Core PATCH before start and while active. Three focused Python cases cover service and API persistence, concurrency, and immutable terminal history. Sixteen component cases cover the complete goal panel including draft/running edits, progress-only revision retries, and retained drafts after content conflicts. Three catalogued real-Core cases exercise the operator journey, persistence, refresh, accessibility, production assets, desktop Chromium, and 390 px Chromium/WebKit mobile profiles on a non-loopback LAN origin.
exclusions: No full suites, unrelated chat/provider tests, native code, or packaging tests. The selected real-Core journey covers the changed server-owned lifecycle across the applicable permanent browser projects. Physical-device coverage is unavailable and is not inferred from emulation.
